<user_query>
你现在是这个项目的主程。

我要开发一个用于【已授权系统】的 Anti-Bot / Anti-Scraping 测试平台，用来模拟恶意爬虫、自动化访问和高频请求，从而验证目标系统的反爬、防刷、接口鉴权、敏感数据保护和风控能力。

目标测试页面：

https://xindai.duxiaoman.com/umoney?tp=xh&activityName=channelBrand&CH=fcdxmpz&fr=Web33X2R5&md_exper=wx_xcx

重要：

这是授权的安全测试/压力测试项目。

不要把项目实现成攻击第三方网站的工具。

不要实现：

* WAF 绕过
* 验证码破解
* IP 伪造
* 住宅代理池
* 第三方代理池
* 真实账号批量注册
* 真实身份证采集
* 真实银行卡采集
* 真实贷款申请
* 真实放款
* 绕过登录
* 绕过访问控制
* 绕过安全验证

所有业务数据必须使用 Mock 数据。

---

## 一、你的执行原则

不要只给我设计方案。

我要你直接在当前 Cursor Workspace 中创建项目并开始写代码。

执行过程中：

1. 先检查当前 Workspace 是否已经存在项目
2. 如果没有，创建项目目录
3. 创建 Python 虚拟环境
4. 创建 requirements.txt
5. 创建 README.md
6. 创建 config.yaml
7. 创建完整项目目录
8. 逐模块实现代码
9. 每完成一个模块立即运行测试
10. 发现错误立即修复
11. 不要停留在“下面是示例代码”
12. 不要生成伪代码
13. 不要只告诉我应该怎么做
14. 必须真正创建文件
15. 必须让项目最终可以直接运行

如果某个功能暂时无法实现，先实现安全的 Mock 版本，不要假装已经实现。

---

## 二、项目名称

anti_bot_tester

目录：

anti_bot_tester/
│
├── app/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── config.py
│   ├── models.py
│   └── constants.py
│
├── crawler/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── http_client.py
│   ├── browser_client.py
│   ├── network_recorder.py
│   └── session_manager.py
│
├── flow/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── flow_recorder.py
│   ├── flow_parser.py
│   └── flow_model.py
│
├── attack/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── base.py
│   ├── normal_user.py
│   ├── crawler.py
│   ├── high_frequency.py
│   ├── concurrent.py
│   ├── replay.py
│   ├── abnormal_behavior.py
│   └── parameter_tampering.py
│
├── security/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── sensitive_detector.py
│   ├── data_masker.py
│   ├── token_checker.py
│   ├── response_checker.py
│   └── security_rules.py
│
├── monitor/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── metrics.py
│   ├── collector.py
│   └── statistics.py
│
├── report/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   ├── json_report.py
│   ├── csv_report.py
│   └── html_report.py
│
├── scenarios/
│   ├── **init**.py
│   └── scenarios.yaml
│
├── tests/
│   ├── test_config.py
│   ├── test_masker.py
│   ├── test_sensitive_detector.py
│   ├── test_metrics.py
│   └── test_attack.py
│
├── reports/
│
├── config.yaml
├── requirements.txt
├── main.py
└── README.md

---

## 三、第一阶段：环境初始化

首先执行：

* 检查 Python 版本
* 创建 .venv
* 创建 requirements.txt
* 安装依赖
* 创建目录结构

优先使用：

Python 3.11+

核心依赖：

aiohttp
playwright
pydantic
pyyaml
rich
pandas
jinja2
pytest
pytest-asyncio

如果当前 Python 环境不是 3.11+，先告诉我当前版本并选择兼容方案。

不要擅自安装无关依赖。

---

## 四、第二阶段：配置系统

创建：

config.yaml

至少包含：

target:
url: "https://xindai.duxiaoman.com/umoney?tp=xh&activityName=channelBrand&CH=fcdxmpz&fr=Web33X2R5&md_exper=wx_xcx"

safety:
max_concurrency: 50
max_qps: 20
max_duration_seconds: 60
max_requests: 1000
stop_on_429_ratio: 0.3
stop_on_403_ratio: 0.3
stop_on_5xx_ratio: 0.2

browser:
headless: true
record_network: true
record_console: true
record_storage: false

test_data:
phone: "13800000000"
id_card: "110101199001010000"
bank_card: "6222000000000000000"

注意：

这些全部只是测试数据。

程序必须禁止用户误把真实身份证、银行卡、手机号写进配置后直接运行。

最好增加：

test_data:
environment: mock

如果不是 mock，程序启动时直接拒绝执行。

---

## 五、第三阶段：Playwright 正常流程分析

第一阶段运行程序时，不进行任何真实申请。

只执行：

页面打开
↓
等待页面加载
↓
记录 URL
↓
记录 Navigation
↓
记录 XHR
↓
记录 Fetch
↓
记录请求 Method
↓
记录 Request Headers
↓
记录 Response Status
↓
记录 Response Headers
↓
记录 Response Size
↓
记录 Response Time
↓
记录 Console
↓
记录页面错误

不要点击“提交申请”。

不要输入真实个人信息。

不要进行真实业务操作。

最终生成：

reports/network_flow.json

以及：

reports/network_flow.html

格式类似：

{
"requests": [
{
"method": "GET",
"url": "...",
"status": 200,
"resource_type": "xhr",
"duration_ms": 123
}
]
}

---

## 六、敏感数据保护

这是本项目最重要的模块之一。

实现敏感字段检测。

至少检测：

手机号

身份证号

银行卡号

姓名

地址

Token

Cookie

Authorization

Session ID

Access Token

Refresh Token

API Key

Secret

检测范围：

URL

Query

Path

Request Header

Request Body

Response Header

Response Body

HTML

JavaScript

Console

Error

日志

检测到敏感数据以后：

严禁原文写入日志。

必须自动 Mask。

例如：

手机号：

138****0000

身份证：

110***********0000

银行卡：

6222**************0000

Authorization：

Bearer ********

Token：

---

---

## 七、HTTP Client

实现：

crawler/http_client.py

使用：

aiohttp

支持：

GET

POST

PUT

DELETE

HEAD

OPTIONS

但是默认只允许：

GET

HEAD

OPTIONS

对于 POST / PUT / DELETE：

必须配置：

allow_mutation_requests: false

默认 false。

如果 false：

禁止向目标系统发送业务变更请求。

---

## 八、攻击场景

实现统一 AttackScenario 接口。

例如：

class AttackScenario

包含：

name

description

run()

stop()

statistics()

实现以下场景：

1. normal_user

正常用户访问行为。

特点：

低频
随机间隔
有限页面访问
单 Session

2. crawler

普通爬虫。

特点：

快速访问
不执行 JS
大量 GET
固定访问顺序

3. high_frequency

高频访问。

4. concurrent

并发访问。

5. replay

请求重放测试。

只允许对 GET / HEAD 等安全请求进行重放。

6. abnormal_behavior

模拟：

异常 UA

异常 Referer

缺失 Header

异常请求间隔

请求顺序异常

7. parameter_tampering

只针对 Mock Flow 或本地测试接口。

不要对真实申请接口进行参数篡改。

---

## 九、压力控制

必须实现 RateLimiter。

支持：

QPS 限制

Concurrency 限制

Duration 限制

Request Count 限制

例如：

并发：

10

50

100

500

1000

但是默认：

max_concurrency = 50

不能直接运行 1000 并发。

如果用户需要提高：

必须修改 config.yaml。

程序启动时打印：

==================================
ANTI-BOT SAFETY LIMIT
=====================

MAX CONCURRENCY : 50
MAX QPS         : 20
MAX DURATION    : 60s
MAX REQUESTS    : 1000

==================================

---

## 十、自动降压

如果连续出现：

429

403

503

或者：

5xx 比例超过阈值

必须自动降低压力。

例如：

20 QPS
↓
10 QPS
↓
5 QPS

不能因为出现 429 就继续加压。

记录：

rate_limit_triggered_at

status_code

current_qps

current_concurrency

---

## 十一、指标系统

实时统计：

total_requests

success_requests

failed_requests

status_200

status_400

status_401

status_403

status_404

status_429

status_500

status_502

status_503

status_504

qps

average_latency

p50

p90

p95

p99

timeout

connection_error

rate_limit_count

security_block_count

---

## 十二、反爬评分

实现 AntiBotScore。

评分：

IP 限流 10

Session 风控 10

请求频率控制 10

并发控制 10

Token 防重放 10

接口鉴权 10

请求顺序控制 10

异常行为检测 10

敏感数据保护 20

总分 100。

报告：

90-100
优秀

80-89
良好

60-79
需要加强

<60
高风险

注意：

评分必须基于实际测试结果。

不能硬编码最终得分。

---

## 十三、报告

测试结束自动生成：

reports/

report.html

report.json

requests.csv

metrics.csv

security_findings.json

report.html 必须包含：

测试时间

测试目标

测试场景

总请求数

QPS

平均响应时间

P50

P95

P99

HTTP 状态码分布

429 数量

403 数量

5xx 数量

限流触发时间

风控触发情况

敏感信息泄漏情况

Anti-Bot Score

风险等级

安全建议

---

## 十四、命令行

最终支持：

python main.py --scenario normal

python main.py --scenario crawler

python main.py --scenario high_frequency

python main.py --scenario concurrent

python main.py --scenario replay

python main.py --scenario abnormal

python main.py --scenario sensitive_data

python main.py --scenario all

支持：

python main.py --dry-run

用于只分析流程，不产生压力。

支持：

python main.py --discover

用于 Playwright 网络流程发现。

支持：

python main.py --report

查看最近一次测试报告。

---

## 十五、非常重要：目标系统保护

必须增加 TargetGuard。

TargetGuard 对目标 URL 做校验。

默认只允许：

https://xindai.duxiaoman.com/

如果目标 URL 不匹配：

直接拒绝运行。

例如：

https://evil.com

必须：

拒绝。

同时禁止：

localhost

127.0.0.1

内网 IP

云厂商 metadata 地址

file://

ftp://

其他协议

防止 SSRF。

---

## 十六、测试模式

项目分成两个模式：

SAFE_DISCOVERY

和：

LOAD_TEST

SAFE_DISCOVERY：

只使用 Playwright。

只做页面加载和网络分析。

不提交业务数据。

默认启用。

LOAD_TEST：

只有用户显式配置后才能启用。

默认：

allow_load_test: false

如果：

allow_load_test != true

那么：

禁止高并发。

禁止压力测试。

---

## 十七、Mock Server

为了测试真正的攻击逻辑，不要所有测试都打真实目标。

增加：

mock_server/

实现本地 Mock API。

例如：

GET /api/page

GET /api/config

GET /api/user

POST /api/apply

POST /api/submit

其中：

/api/user

可以返回：

{
"name": "TEST_USER",
"phone": "13800000000",
"idCard": "110101199001010000"
}

然后验证：

敏感字段检测

脱敏

日志保护

响应检测

Replay

Parameter Tampering

等功能。

真实目标只用于：

SAFE_DISCOVERY。

攻击场景优先跑：

Mock Server。

---

必须给项目写 pytest。

# Anti-Bot Tester

Authorized **Anti-Bot / Anti-Scraping** test platform for validating a system's
anti-crawl, rate-limit, auth, sensitive-data protection, and risk-control
capabilities.

> **Security boundary**: This is NOT a general attack toolkit.
> It does not implement WAF bypass, captcha cracking, IP spoofing, proxy pools,
> real account registration, real PII collection, real loan applications,
> login bypass, or access-control bypass. All business payloads are **Mock**.

## Purpose

- Discover network flows of an authorized target page (SAFE_DISCOVERY)
- Simulate crawler / high-frequency / concurrent / abnormal client patterns
  against a **local Mock Server**
- Detect and mask sensitive fields in logs and reports
- Score anti-bot posture from observed responses
- Produce HTML / JSON / CSV reports

## Safety limits (defaults)

| Limit | Default |
|-------|---------|
| max_concurrency | 50 |
| max_qps | 20 |
| max_duration_seconds | 60 |
| max_requests | 1000 |
| allow_mutation_requests | false |
| allow_load_test | false |
| test_data.environment | mock (required) |

TargetGuard only allows `https://xindai.duxiaoman.com/` by default.
Localhost / private IP / metadata / non-HTTPS targets are rejected for SSRF prevention
(except the built-in Mock Server used for attack scenarios).

## Install

```bash
cd anti_bot_tester
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium
```

Requires **Python 3.11+**.

## Modes

### SAFE_DISCOVERY (default)

- Playwright page open + network recording only
- No form submit, no real PII input, no business mutation
- Output: `reports/network_flow.json` / `reports/network_flow.html`

```bash
python main.py --discover
```

### Mock Server (attack scenarios)

Attack scenarios (`normal`, `crawler`, `high_frequency`, …) hit the local Mock API,
not the real loan application endpoints.

```bash
python main.py --scenario normal
python main.py --scenario crawler
```

### LOAD_TEST

Disabled unless `safety.allow_load_test: true` in `config.yaml`.
Without that flag, high-concurrency pressure tests are refused.

```bash
# after explicitly enabling allow_load_test in config.yaml
python main.py --scenario concurrent
```

## CLI

```bash
python main.py --discover
python main.py --dry-run
python main.py --scenario normal
python main.py --scenario crawler
python main.py --scenario high_frequency
python main.py --scenario concurrent
python main.py --scenario replay
python main.py --scenario abnormal
python main.py --scenario sensitive_data
python main.py --scenario all
python main.py --report
```

## Configuration

Edit `config.yaml`. Key sections:

- `target` — authorized URL + allowlist
- `safety` — QPS / concurrency / duration / mutation gates
- `test_data` — **must** set `environment: mock`
- `mock_server` — local mock bind address
- `browser` — Playwright options

"""Configuration loader with safety validation."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml
from pydantic import ValidationError

from app.constants import MOCK_ENVIRONMENT, SAFETY_BANNER
from app.models import AppConfig
from app.safety_guard import SafetyGuard
from app.target_guard import TargetGuard


class ConfigError(Exception):
    """Raised when configuration is invalid or unsafe."""


def load_raw_yaml(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise ConfigError(f"Config file not found: {config_path}")
    try:
        data = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
        raise ConfigError(f"Invalid YAML: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ConfigError("Config root must be a mapping")
    return data


def load_config(path: str | Path, *, validate_target: bool = True) -> AppConfig:
    """Load and validate config.yaml.

    Refuses to start when:
    - test_data.environment != mock
    - target URL fails TargetGuard (when validate_target=True)
    - LOAD_TEST without allow_load_test
    """
    raw = load_raw_yaml(path)

    # Pre-check environment before pydantic for clearer error
    test_data = raw.get("test_data") or {}
    env = test_data.get("environment", MOCK_ENVIRONMENT)
    if env != MOCK_ENVIRONMENT:
        raise ConfigError(
            f"Refusing to start: test_data.environment={env!r} "
            f"(must be {MOCK_ENVIRONMENT!r}). "
            "Do not put real PII into config."
        )

    try:
        config = AppConfig.model_validate(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise ConfigError(str(exc)) from exc

    if validate_target:
        TargetGuard(config).assert_allowed(config.target.url)

    SafetyGuard(config).assert_startup_safe()
    return config


def format_safety_banner(config: AppConfig) -> str:
    return SAFETY_BANNER.format(
        max_concurrency=config.safety.max_concurrency,
        max_qps=config.safety.max_qps,
        max_duration_seconds=config.safety.max_duration_seconds,
        max_requests=config.safety.max_requests,
    )


def print_safety_banner(config: AppConfig) -> None:
    print(format_safety_banner(config))

    def __init__(self, config: AppConfig) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.safety = SafetyGuard(config)
        self.target_guard = TargetGuard(config)

    async def discover(self, url: str | None = None) -> NetworkFlow:
        target = url or self.config.target.url
        self.target_guard.assert_allowed(target)
        self.safety.assert_startup_safe()

        try:
            from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
        except ImportError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "playwright is not installed. Run: pip install playwright && "
                "playwright install chromium"
            ) from exc

        recorder = NetworkRecorder()
        started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        final_url: str | None = None
        error: str | None = None

        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=self.config.browser.headless)
            context = await browser.new_context(
                user_agent=self.config.http.default_headers.get(
                    "User-Agent",
                    "AntiBotTester/1.0 (authorized-security-test; mock-only)",
                )
            )
            page = await context.new_page()
            page.set_default_timeout(self.config.browser.navigation_timeout_ms)
            if self.config.browser.record_network or self.config.browser.record_console:
                recorder.attach(page)

            try:
                await page.goto(
                    target,
                    wait_until="domcontentloaded",
                    timeout=self.config.browser.navigation_timeout_ms,
                )
                # Extra settle time for XHR/fetch after DOM ready
                await page.wait_for_timeout(self.config.browser.wait_after_load_ms)
                try:
                    await page.wait_for_load_state(
                        "networkidle",
                        timeout=min(10000, self.config.browser.navigation_timeout_ms),
                    )
                except Exception:
                    # networkidle may not settle on long-polling pages — OK
                    pass
                final_url = page.url
            except Exception as exc:
                error = str(exc)
                try:
                    final_url = page.url
                except Exception:
                    final_url = target
            finally:
                await context.close()
                await browser.close()

        finished = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        meta: dict[str, Any] = {
            "mode": "SAFE_DISCOVERY",
            "headless": self.config.browser.headless,
            "no_submit": True,
            "no_pii_input": True,
        }
        if error:
            meta["navigation_error"] = error[:500]

        flow = recorder.to_flow(
            target_url=target,
            final_url=final_url,
            started_at=started,
            finished_at=finished,
            meta=meta,
        )
        return flow

    def save_reports(
        self, flow: NetworkFlow, output_dir: str | Path | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Path]:
        out_dir = Path(output_dir or self.config.report.output_dir)
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fr = FlowRecorder()
        paths = {
            "json": fr.save_json(flow, out_dir / "network_flow.json"),
            "html": fr.save_html(flow, out_dir / "network_flow.html"),
            "full_json": fr.save_full_json(flow, out_dir / "network_flow_full.json"),
        }
        summary = FlowParser().summary(flow)
        (out_dir / "network_flow_summary.json").write_text(
            __import__("json").dumps(summary, indent=2),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        paths["summary"] = out_dir / "network_flow_summary.json"
        return paths

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="anti_bot_tester",
        description="Authorized Anti-Bot / Anti-Scraping test platform (mock-first).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--scenario",
        choices=[
            "normal",
            "crawler",
            "high_frequency",
            "concurrent",
            "replay",
            "abnormal",
            "sensitive_data",
            "all",
        ],
        help="Run an attack scenario (targets Mock Server by default).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--discover",
        action="store_true",
        help="SAFE_DISCOVERY: Playwright network flow analysis only.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Analyze flow / print plan without generating load.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--report",
        action="store_true",
        help="Show the most recent test report.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        default=str(ROOT / "config.yaml"),
        help="Path to config.yaml",
    )
    return parser


async def run_discover(config) -> int:
    from crawler.browser_client import BrowserClient
    from flow.flow_parser import FlowParser
    from rich.console import Console

    console = Console()
    console.print("[bold]SAFE_DISCOVERY[/bold] — page open + network record only")
    console.print("No submit / no PII input / no business mutation.")
    client = BrowserClient(config)
    flow = await client.discover()
    paths = client.save_reports(flow)
    summary = FlowParser().summary(flow)
    console.print(f"Final URL : {flow.final_url}")
    console.print(f"Requests  : {summary['total_requests']}")
    console.print(f"By status : {summary['by_status']}")
    console.print(f"By type   : {summary['by_type']}")
    console.print(f"Wrote     : {paths['json']}")
    console.print(f"Wrote     : {paths['html']}")
    if flow.meta.get("navigation_error"):
        console.print(f"[yellow]Navigation note:[/yellow] {flow.meta['navigation_error']}")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    from app.config import ConfigError, load_config, print_safety_banner

    try:
        config = load_config(args.config)
    except ConfigError as exc:
        print(f"[FATAL] Config rejected: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print_safety_banner(config)
    print(f"mode              : {config.mode}")
    print(f"allow_load_test   : {config.safety.allow_load_test}")
    print(f"allow_mutation    : {config.safety.allow_mutation_requests}")
    print(f"test_data.env     : {config.test_data.environment}")

        print("Use --discover for SAFE_DISCOVERY now.")
        return 0

    parser.print_help()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""aiohttp-based HTTP client with mutation guards."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from typing import Any

import aiohttp

from app.constants import ALLOWED_SAFE_METHODS, MUTATION_METHODS
from app.models import AppConfig
from app.safety_guard import SafetyGuard, SafetyGuardError


class HttpClientError(Exception):
    pass


class HttpResponse:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        method: str,
        url: str,
        status: int,
        headers: dict[str, str],
        body: str,
        duration_ms: float,
        error: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.method = method
        self.url = url
        self.status = status
        self.headers = headers
        self.body = body
        self.duration_ms = duration_ms
        self.error = error

    def json(self) -> Any:
        import json

        return json.loads(self.body)


class HttpClient:
    """HTTP client. Default: only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS to real targets.

    When use_mock=True, POST/PUT/DELETE may be used against Mock Server only.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: AppConfig,
        *,
        use_mock: bool = True,
        session: aiohttp.ClientSession | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.use_mock = use_mock
        self.safety = SafetyGuard(config)
        self._session = session
        self._owned_session = session is None

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "HttpClient":
        if self._session is None:
            timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=self.config.http.timeout_seconds)
            self._session = aiohttp.ClientSession(
                timeout=timeout,
                headers=dict(self.config.http.default_headers),
            )
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *exc: Any) -> None:
        if self._owned_session and self._session is not None:
            await self._session.close()
            self._session = None

    def _resolve_url(self, path_or_url: str) -> str:
        if path_or_url.startswith("http://") or path_or_url.startswith("https://"):
            return path_or_url
        base = (
            self.config.mock_server.base_url
            if self.use_mock
            else self.config.target.url.split("?")[0].rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        )
        return base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path_or_url.lstrip("/")

    def _assert_method(self, method: str) -> None:
        m = method.upper()
        if m in ALLOWED_SAFE_METHODS:
            return
        if m in MUTATION_METHODS:
            if not self.use_mock and not self.config.safety.allow_mutation_requests:
                raise SafetyGuardError(
                    f"{m} blocked: allow_mutation_requests=false and not using mock"
                )
            if not self.use_mock:
                raise SafetyGuardError(f"{m} to real target is not allowed by default")
            return
        raise SafetyGuardError(f"Unsupported method {m}")

    async def request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path_or_url: str,
        *,
        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        json_body: Any = None,
        data: Any = None,
    ) -> HttpResponse:
        if self._session is None:
            raise HttpClientError("HttpClient not started; use 'async with'")

        self._assert_method(method)
        url = self._resolve_url(path_or_url)
        self.safety.assert_url_for_request(
            url, use_mock=self.use_mock, method=method
        )

        started = time.time()
        try:
            async with self._session.request(
                method.upper(),
                url,
                headers=headers,
                json=json_body,
                data=data,
            ) as resp:
                body = await resp.text()
                duration = round((time.time() - started) * 1000, 2)
                return HttpResponse(
                    method=method.upper(),
                    url=str(resp.url),
                    status=resp.status,
                    headers={k: v for k, v in resp.headers.items()},
                    body=body,
                    duration_ms=duration,
                )
        except aiohttp.ClientError as exc:
            duration = round((time.time() - started) * 1000, 2)
            return HttpResponse(
                method=method.upper(),
                url=url,
                status=0,
                headers={},
                body="",
                duration_ms=duration,
                error=str(exc),
            )

    async def get(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("GET", path_or_url, **kwargs)

    async def head(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("HEAD", path_or_url, **kwargs)

    async def options(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("OPTIONS", path_or_url, **kwargs)

    async def post(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("POST", path_or_url, **kwargs)

    async def put(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("PUT", path_or_url, **kwargs)

    async def delete(self, path_or_url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HttpResponse:
        return await self.request("DELETE", path_or_url, **kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from crawler.http_client import HttpResponse
from security.sensitive_detector import DetectionResult, SensitiveDetector


@dataclass
class ResponseCheckResult:
    status: int
    blocked: bool
    rate_limited: bool
    server_error: bool
    sensitive: DetectionResult = field(default_factory=DetectionResult)
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


class ResponseChecker:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.detector = SensitiveDetector()

    def check(self, resp: HttpResponse) -> ResponseCheckResult:
        status = resp.status
        result = ResponseCheckResult(
            status=status,
            blocked=status in {401, 403},
            rate_limited=status == 429,
            server_error=status >= 500,
        )
        if result.rate_limited:
            result.notes.append("rate_limit_429")
        if result.blocked:
            result.notes.append("security_block")
        if result.server_error:
            result.notes.append("server_error")
        result.sensitive = self.detector.scan_parts(
            url=resp.url,
            response_headers=resp.headers,
            response_body=resp.body,
        )
        if result.sensitive.count:
            result.notes.append(f"sensitive_findings={result.sensitive.count}")
        return result

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class ScoreBreakdown:
    ip_rate_limit: int = 0
    session_risk: int = 0
    request_frequency: int = 0
    concurrency_control: int = 0
    token_anti_replay: int = 0
    api_auth: int = 0
    request_order: int = 0
    abnormal_behavior: int = 0
    sensitive_data_protection: int = 0
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def total(self) -> int:
        return (
            self.ip_rate_limit
            + self.session_risk
            + self.request_frequency
            + self.concurrency_control
            + self.token_anti_replay
            + self.api_auth
            + self.request_order
            + self.abnormal_behavior
            + self.sensitive_data_protection
        )

    def risk_level(self) -> str:
        t = self.total
        if t >= 90:
            return "优秀"
        if t >= 80:
            return "良好"
        if t >= 60:
            return "需要加强"
        return "高风险"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "scores": {
                "ip_rate_limit": self.ip_rate_limit,
                "session_risk": self.session_risk,
                "request_frequency": self.request_frequency,
                "concurrency_control": self.concurrency_control,
                "token_anti_replay": self.token_anti_replay,
                "api_auth": self.api_auth,
                "request_order": self.request_order,
                "abnormal_behavior": self.abnormal_behavior,
                "sensitive_data_protection": self.sensitive_data_protection,
            },
            "total": self.total,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level(),
            "notes": self.notes,

from __future__ import annotations

import statistics
import time
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from crawler.http_client import HttpResponse

@dataclass
class RateLimitEvent:
    rate_limit_triggered_at: str
    status_code: int
    current_qps: float
    current_concurrency: int


class MetricsCollector:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.total_requests = 0
        self.success_requests = 0
        self.failed_requests = 0
        self.status_counts: dict[int, int] = {}
        self.latencies_ms: list[float] = []
        self.timeout = 0
        self.connection_error = 0
        self.rate_limit_count = 0
        self.security_block_count = 0
        self.rate_limit_events: list[RateLimitEvent] = []
        self._started_at = time.time()
        self._lock_note = ""

    def record_response(self, resp: HttpResponse) -> None:
        self.total_requests += 1
        self.latencies_ms.append(resp.duration_ms)
        status = resp.status
        self.status_counts[status] = self.status_counts.get(status, 0) + 1
        if resp.error:
            self.failed_requests += 1
            err_l = resp.error.lower()
            if "timeout" in err_l:
                self.timeout += 1
            else:
                self.connection_error += 1
            return
        if 200 <= status < 400:
            self.success_requests += 1
        else:
            self.failed_requests += 1
        if status == 429:
            self.rate_limit_count += 1
        if status in {401, 403}:
            self.security_block_count += 1

    def record_rate_limit_event(
        self, *, status_code: int, current_qps: float, current_concurrency: int
    ) -> None:
        from datetime import datetime, timezone

        self.rate_limit_events.append(
            RateLimitEvent(
                rate_limit_triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                status_code=status_code,
                current_qps=current_qps,
                current_concurrency=current_concurrency,
            )
        )

    def _percentile(self, p: float) -> float:
        if not self.latencies_ms:
            return 0.0
        xs = sorted(self.latencies_ms)
        k = int(round((p / 100.0) * (len(xs) - 1)))
        return round(xs[k], 2)

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        elapsed = max(time.time() - self._started_at, 1e-6)
        qps = self.total_requests / elapsed
        avg = (
            round(statistics.mean(self.latencies_ms), 2) if self.latencies_ms else 0.0
        )
        sc = self.status_counts

        def st(code: int) -> int:
            return sc.get(code, 0)

        return {
            "total_requests": self.total_requests,
            "success_requests": self.success_requests,
            "failed_requests": self.failed_requests,
            "status_200": st(200),
            "status_400": st(400),
            "status_401": st(401),
            "status_403": st(403),
            "status_404": st(404),
            "status_429": st(429),
            "status_500": st(500),
            "status_502": st(502),
            "status_503": st(503),
            "status_504": st(504),
            "qps": round(qps, 3),
            "average_latency": avg,
            "p50": self._percentile(50),
            "p90": self._percentile(90),
            "p95": self._percentile(95),
            "p99": self._percentile(99),
            "timeout": self.timeout,
            "connection_error": self.connection_error,
            "rate_limit_count": self.rate_limit_count,
            "security_block_count": self.security_block_count,
            "rate_limit_events": [e.__dict__ for e in self.rate_limit_events],
            "status_counts": dict(self.status_counts),
        }


class AntiBotScore:
    """Score anti-bot posture from observed metrics + scenario extras.

    Must be derived from actual results — never hardcode the final score.
    """

    def compute(
        self,
        metrics: MetricsCollector,
        *,
        extras: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ScoreBreakdown:
        snap = metrics.snapshot()
        extras = extras or {}
        score = ScoreBreakdown()
        total = max(snap["total_requests"], 1)

        # IP / rate limit signals
        if snap["status_429"] > 0 or snap["rate_limit_count"] > 0:
            score.ip_rate_limit = SCORE_MAX["ip_rate_limit"]
            score.notes.append("Observed 429 / rate limiting")
        elif snap["status_403"] / total >= 0.2:
            score.ip_rate_limit = 5
            score.notes.append("Elevated 403 may indicate blocking")

        # Session risk
        if extras.get("session_blocked"):
            score.session_risk = SCORE_MAX["session_risk"]
        elif snap["security_block_count"] > 0:
            score.session_risk = 6

        # Request frequency control
        if snap["rate_limit_count"] > 0 or extras.get("frequency_throttled"):
            score.request_frequency = SCORE_MAX["request_frequency"]
        elif snap["qps"] < 5 and snap["failed_requests"] == 0:
            score.request_frequency = 3  # not stressed enough to prove control

        # Concurrency control
        if extras.get("concurrency_limited") or snap["status_429"] > 0:
            score.concurrency_control = SCORE_MAX["concurrency_control"]
        elif extras.get("high_concurrency_ran"):
            score.concurrency_control = 4

        # Token anti-replay
        if extras.get("token_replay_blocked"):
            score.token_anti_replay = SCORE_MAX["token_anti_replay"]
            score.notes.append("Token replay blocked on mock")
        elif extras.get("token_auth_enforced"):
            score.token_anti_replay = 5

        # API auth
        if extras.get("api_auth_401") or snap["status_401"] > 0:
            score.api_auth = SCORE_MAX["api_auth"]
        elif extras.get("api_auth_checked"):
            score.api_auth = 4

        # Request order
        if extras.get("order_enforced"):
            score.request_order = SCORE_MAX["request_order"]
        elif extras.get("abnormal_order_tested"):
            score.request_order = 3

        # Abnormal behavior detection
        if extras.get("abnormal_blocked"):
            score.abnormal_behavior = SCORE_MAX["abnormal_behavior"]
        elif extras.get("abnormal_tested"):
            score.abnormal_behavior = 4

        # Sensitive data protection (20 pts) — based on masking / leakage checks
        leak_count = int(extras.get("sensitive_leak_raw_count", 0))
        findings = int(extras.get("sensitive_findings", 0))
        if findings > 0 and leak_count == 0 and extras.get("masking_verified"):
            score.sensitive_data_protection = SCORE_MAX["sensitive_data_protection"]
            score.notes.append("Sensitive fields detected and masked in reports")
        elif findings > 0 and leak_count == 0:
            score.sensitive_data_protection = 12
        elif leak_count > 0:
            score.sensitive_data_protection = 0
            score.notes.append("Raw sensitive data leaked into logs/reports")
        else:
            score.sensitive_data_protection = 5
            score.notes.append("No sensitive payload observed in this run")

        return score

"""Rate / concurrency limiters and auto-backoff."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass

from monitor.metrics import MetricsCollector


class RateLimiter:
    """Token-bucket style QPS limiter."""

    def __init__(self, max_qps: float) -> None:
        self.max_qps = max(0.1, float(max_qps))
        self._interval = 1.0 / self.max_qps
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._next_time = 0.0

    async def acquire(self) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if self._next_time <= now:
                self._next_time = now + self._interval
                return
            delay = self._next_time - now
            self._next_time += self._interval
        await asyncio.sleep(delay)

    def set_qps(self, max_qps: float) -> None:
        self.max_qps = max(0.1, float(max_qps))
        self._interval = 1.0 / self.max_qps


class ConcurrencyLimiter:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int) -> None:
        self.max_concurrency = max(1, int(max_concurrency))
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(self.max_concurrency)

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "ConcurrencyLimiter":
        await self._sem.acquire()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *exc) -> None:
        self._sem.release()

    def set_concurrency(self, n: int) -> None:
        # Recreate semaphore (best-effort; in-flight tasks keep old permits)
        self.max_concurrency = max(1, int(n))
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(self.max_concurrency)


@dataclass
class BackoffState:
    current_qps: float
    current_concurrency: int
    triggered: bool = False


class AutoBackoff:
    """Reduce pressure when 429/403/5xx ratios exceed thresholds."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        initial_qps: float,
        initial_concurrency: int,
        stop_on_429_ratio: float,
        stop_on_403_ratio: float,
        stop_on_5xx_ratio: float,
        metrics: MetricsCollector,
        rate_limiter: RateLimiter,
        concurrency_limiter: ConcurrencyLimiter,
    ) -> None:
        self.state = BackoffState(
            current_qps=initial_qps, current_concurrency=initial_concurrency
        )
        self.stop_on_429_ratio = stop_on_429_ratio
        self.stop_on_403_ratio = stop_on_403_ratio
        self.stop_on_5xx_ratio = stop_on_5xx_ratio
        self.metrics = metrics
        self.rate_limiter = rate_limiter
        self.concurrency_limiter = concurrency_limiter
        self._recent_status: deque[int] = deque(maxlen=50)

    def observe(self, status: int) -> bool:
        """Return True if caller should stop the scenario."""
        self._recent_status.append(status)
        if len(self._recent_status) < 10:
            return False
        total = len(self._recent_status)
        r429 = sum(1 for s in self._recent_status if s == 429) / total
        r403 = sum(1 for s in self._recent_status if s == 403) / total
        r5xx = sum(1 for s in self._recent_status if s >= 500) / total

        if status in {429, 403, 503} or r429 >= self.stop_on_429_ratio or r403 >= self.stop_on_403_ratio or r5xx >= self.stop_on_5xx_ratio:
            self._backoff(status)
            if (
                r429 >= self.stop_on_429_ratio
                or r403 >= self.stop_on_403_ratio
                or r5xx >= self.stop_on_5xx_ratio
            ):
                return True
        return False

    def _backoff(self, status: int) -> None:
        new_qps = max(1.0, self.state.current_qps / 2.0)
        new_conc = max(1, self.state.current_concurrency // 2)
        self.state.current_qps = new_qps
        self.state.current_concurrency = new_conc
        self.state.triggered = True
        self.rate_limiter.set_qps(new_qps)
        self.concurrency_limiter.set_concurrency(new_conc)
        self.metrics.record_rate_limit_event(
            status_code=status,
            current_qps=new_qps,
            current_concurrency=new_conc,
        )

"""Concurrent clients within max_concurrency — mock only.

LOAD_TEST gate: if allow_load_test is false, concurrency is capped low
and scenario still runs gently against mock (not refused entirely),
because mock is local. Real-target pressure remains blocked elsewhere.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time

from attack.base import AttackScenario, ScenarioResult
from crawler.http_client import HttpClient
from monitor.collector import ConcurrencyLimiter, RateLimiter


class ConcurrentScenario(AttackScenario):
    name = "concurrent"
    description = "Concurrent GET workers against Mock Server within safety caps"

    async def run(self) -> ScenarioResult:
        started = time.time()
        responses = []
        # Soft cap when load test not explicitly enabled
        if self.config.safety.allow_load_test:
            workers = min(self.config.safety.max_concurrency, 50)
        else:
            workers = min(5, self.config.safety.max_concurrency)

        limiter = RateLimiter(min(self.config.safety.max_qps, 20.0))
        conc = ConcurrencyLimiter(workers)
        max_n = min(workers * 4, self.config.safety.max_requests)
        lock = asyncio.Lock()

        async def worker(client: HttpClient, n: int) -> None:
            for _ in range(n):
                if self._should_stop():
                    return
                if time.time() - started > self.config.safety.max_duration_seconds:
                    return
                await limiter.acquire()
                async with conc:
                    resp = await client.get("/api/health")
                async with lock:
                    responses.append(resp)
                await self._record(resp)

        per_worker = max(1, max_n // workers)
        async with HttpClient(self.config, use_mock=True) as client:
            await asyncio.gather(*[worker(client, per_worker) for _ in range(workers)])

        self._result = ScenarioResult(
            name=self.name,
            description=self.description,
            started_at=started,
            finished_at=time.time(),
            responses=responses,
            extra={
                "target": "mock",
                "workers": workers,
                "high_concurrency_ran": self.config.safety.allow_load_test,
                "concurrency_limited": not self.config.safety.allow_load_test,
            },
        )
        return self._result

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from monitor.metrics import AntiBotScore, MetricsCollector
from report.csv_report import write_metrics_csv, write_requests_csv
from report.html_report import write_html_report
from report.json_report import write_json_report
from security.security_rules import ScoreBreakdown


def build_recommendations(score: ScoreBreakdown, metrics: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    tips: list[str] = []
    if score.ip_rate_limit < 10:
        tips.append("Strengthen IP / edge rate limiting (expect clear 429 under abuse).")
    if score.token_anti_replay < 10:
        tips.append("Enforce single-use / anti-replay tokens on sensitive actions.")
    if score.api_auth < 10:
        tips.append("Reject unauthenticated API calls with 401 consistently.")
    if score.abnormal_behavior < 10:
        tips.append("Detect abnormal UA / referer / timing patterns.")
    if score.sensitive_data_protection < 20:
        tips.append("Avoid returning raw PII in public API responses; mask at source.")
    if metrics.get("status_5xx", 0) or (
        metrics.get("status_500", 0)
        + metrics.get("status_502", 0)
        + metrics.get("status_503", 0)
        + metrics.get("status_504", 0)
    ):
        tips.append("Investigate 5xx under load; fail closed with controlled errors.")
    if not tips:
        tips.append("Controls look solid on this run; re-test after rule changes.")
    return tips


def generate_reports(
    *,
    output_dir: str | Path,
    target: str,
    scenario_names: list[str],
    metrics: MetricsCollector,
    extras: dict[str, Any],
    request_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    security_findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Path]:
    out_dir = Path(output_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    snap = metrics.snapshot()
    score = AntiBotScore().compute(metrics, extras=extras)
    score_dict = score.to_dict()

    report = {
        "test_time": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "target": target,
        "scenarios": scenario_names,
        "metrics": snap,
        "score": score_dict,
        "extras": extras,
        "security_findings_count": len(security_findings),
        "sensitive_leak_raw_count": extras.get("sensitive_leak_raw_count", 0),
        "recommendations": build_recommendations(score, snap),
    }

    paths = {
        "report_json": write_json_report(out_dir / "report.json", report),
        "report_html": write_html_report(out_dir / "report.html", report),
        "requests_csv": write_requests_csv(out_dir / "requests.csv", request_rows),
        "metrics_csv": write_metrics_csv(out_dir / "metrics.csv", snap),
        "security_findings": write_json_report(
            out_dir / "security_findings.json",
            {"findings": security_findings},
        ),
    }
    return paths

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="anti_bot_tester",
        description="Authorized Anti-Bot / Anti-Scraping test platform (mock-first).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--scenario",
        choices=[
            "normal",
            "crawler",
            "high_frequency",
            "concurrent",
            "replay",
            "abnormal",
            "sensitive_data",
            "all",
        ],
        help="Run an attack scenario (targets Mock Server by default).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--discover",
        action="store_true",
        help="SAFE_DISCOVERY: Playwright network flow analysis only.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Analyze flow / print plan without generating load.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--report",
        action="store_true",
        help="Show the most recent test report.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        default=str(ROOT / "config.yaml"),
        help="Path to config.yaml",
    )
    return parser


async def run_discover(config) -> int:
    from crawler.browser_client import BrowserClient
    from flow.flow_parser import FlowParser
    from rich.console import Console

    console = Console()
    console.print("[bold]SAFE_DISCOVERY[/bold] — page open + network record only")
    console.print("No submit / no PII input / no business mutation.")
    client = BrowserClient(config)
    flow = await client.discover()
    paths = client.save_reports(flow)
    summary = FlowParser().summary(flow)
    console.print(f"Final URL : {flow.final_url}")
    console.print(f"Requests  : {summary['total_requests']}")
    console.print(f"By status : {summary['by_status']}")
    console.print(f"Wrote     : {paths['json']}")
    console.print(f"Wrote     : {paths['html']}")
    if flow.meta.get("navigation_error"):
        console.print(f"[yellow]Navigation note:[/yellow] {flow.meta['navigation_error']}")
    return 0


async def run_scenarios(config, names: list[str]) -> int:
    from attack import SCENARIO_MAP
    from mock_server.server import MockServer
    from monitor.metrics import MetricsCollector
    from report import generate_reports
    from rich.console import Console
    from security.data_masker import DataMasker
    from security.sensitive_detector import SensitiveDetector

    console = Console()
    metrics = MetricsCollector()
    extras: dict = {}
    request_rows: list[dict] = []
    security_findings: list[dict] = []
    detector = SensitiveDetector()
    masker = DataMasker()

    server = MockServer(
        host=config.mock_server.host,
        port=config.mock_server.port,
    )
    base = await server.start()
    config.mock_server.base_url = base
    console.print(f"[green]Mock Server[/green] {base}")

    try:
        for name in names:
            cls = SCENARIO_MAP[name]
            scenario = cls(config, metrics=metrics)
            console.print(f"[bold]Running scenario:[/bold] {scenario.name}")
            result = await scenario.run()
            stats = result.statistics()
            console.print(f"  requests={stats['total_requests']} by_status={stats['by_status']}")
            for k, v in result.extra.items():
                if isinstance(v, (bool, int, float, str)):
                    extras[k] = v if k not in extras else extras[k] or v
                elif isinstance(v, dict):
                    extras[k] = v
            for resp in result.responses:
                masked_body = masker.mask_text(resp.body[:500] if resp.body else "")
                request_rows.append(
                    {
                        "scenario": scenario.name,
                        "method": resp.method,
                        "url": resp.url,
                        "status": resp.status,
                        "duration_ms": resp.duration_ms,
                        "body_preview_masked": masked_body,
                        "error": resp.error or "",
                    }
                )
                det = detector.scan_parts(
                    url=resp.url,
                    response_headers=resp.headers,
                    response_body=resp.body or "",
                )
                for f in det.findings:
                    security_findings.append(
                        {
                            "scenario": scenario.name,
                            "category": f.category,
                            "location": f.location,
                            "matched_preview": f.matched_preview,
                            "pattern_name": f.pattern_name,
                        }
                    )
    finally:
        await server.stop()

    paths = generate_reports(
        output_dir=config.report.output_dir,
        target=f"mock:{config.mock_server.base_url} (discover-target={config.target.url})",
        scenario_names=names,
        metrics=metrics,
        extras=extras,
        request_rows=request_rows,
        security_findings=security_findings,
    )
    snap = metrics.snapshot()
    console.print(f"Total requests : {snap['total_requests']}")
    console.print(f"QPS            : {snap['qps']}")
    console.print(f"P95            : {snap['p95']}")
    console.print(f"Report HTML    : {paths['report_html']}")
    console.print(f"Report JSON    : {paths['report_json']}")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    from app.config import ConfigError, load_config, print_safety_banner
    from attack import SCENARIO_MAP

    try:
        config = load_config(args.config)
    except ConfigError as exc:
        print(f"[FATAL] Config rejected: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print_safety_banner(config)
    print(f"mode              : {config.mode}")
    print(f"allow_load_test   : {config.safety.allow_load_test}")
    print(f"allow_mutation    : {config.safety.allow_mutation_requests}")
    print(f"test_data.env     : {config.test_data.environment}")
    print()

    if args.discover:
        return asyncio.run(run_discover(config))

    if args.dry_run:
        print("[dry-run] Plan only — no load generated.")
        print(f"  discover_target = {config.target.url}")
        print(f"  mock_server     = {config.mock_server.base_url}")
        print(f"  scenarios       = {list(SCENARIO_MAP)}")
        print("  SAFE_DISCOVERY uses Playwright; attack scenarios use Mock Server.")
        return 0

    if args.report:
        report = Path(config.report.output_dir) / "report.html"
        alt = Path(config.report.output_dir) / "network_flow.json"
        if report.exists():
            print(f"Latest report: {report}")
            print(report.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:1500])
            return 0
        if alt.exists():
            print(f"Latest discover flow: {alt}")
            return 0
        print("No report found. Run --scenario or --discover first.")
        return 1

    if args.scenario:
        if args.scenario == "all":
            names = list(SCENARIO_MAP.keys())
        else:
            names = [args.scenario]
        return asyncio.run(run_scenarios(config, names))

    parser.print_help()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def _resp(status: int, duration: float = 10.0) -> HttpResponse:
    return HttpResponse(
        method="GET",

        status=status,
        headers={},
        body="{}",

    )


def test_metrics_counts_and_percentiles():
    m = MetricsCollector()
    for i, s in enumerate([200, 200, 429, 403, 500]):
        m.record_response(_resp(s, duration=float(i + 1) * 10))
    snap = m.snapshot()
    assert snap["total_requests"] == 5
    assert snap["status_200"] == 2
    assert snap["status_429"] == 1
    assert snap["status_403"] == 1
    assert snap["status_500"] == 1
    assert snap["p50"] > 0
    assert snap["rate_limit_count"] == 1
    assert snap["security_block_count"] == 1


def test_antibot_score_from_results():
    m = MetricsCollector()
    m.record_response(_resp(429))
    m.record_response(_resp(401))
    score = AntiBotScore().compute(
        m,
        extras={
            "token_replay_blocked": True,
            "masking_verified": True,
            "sensitive_findings": 3,
            "sensitive_leak_raw_count": 0,
            "abnormal_blocked": True,
            "api_auth_401": True,
        },
    )
    assert score.total > 0
    assert score.total <= 100
    assert score.ip_rate_limit == 10
    assert score.token_anti_replay == 10
    assert score.sensitive_data_protection == 20
    d = score.to_dict()
    assert "risk_level" in d


def test_rate_limiter_set_qps():
    rl = RateLimiter(20)
    assert rl.max_qps == 20
    rl.set_qps(5)
    assert rl.max_qps == 5


def test_auto_backoff_reduces_qps():
    m = MetricsCollector()
    rl = RateLimiter(20)
    cl = ConcurrencyLimiter(10)
    ab = AutoBackoff(
        initial_qps=20,
        initial_concurrency=10,
        stop_on_429_ratio=0.3,
        stop_on_403_ratio=0.3,
        stop_on_5xx_ratio=0.2,
        metrics=m,
        rate_limiter=rl,
        concurrency_limiter=cl,
    )
    # Feed enough 429s
    should_stop = False
    for _ in range(15):
        should_stop = ab.observe(429) or should_stop
    assert ab.state.triggered
    assert ab.state.current_qps < 20
    assert m.rate_limit_events
    assert should_stop

# Anti-Bot Tester — authorized anti-bot / anti-scraping validation platform.

Authorized **Anti-Bot / Anti-Scraping** test platform for validating a system's
anti-crawl, rate-limit, auth, sensitive-data protection, and risk-control
capabilities.

> **Security boundary**: This is NOT a general attack toolkit.
> It does not implement WAF bypass, captcha cracking, IP spoofing, proxy pools,
> real account registration, real PII collection, real loan applications,
> login bypass, or access-control bypass. All business payloads are **Mock**.

## Purpose

- Discover network flows of an authorized target page (SAFE_DISCOVERY)
- Simulate crawler / high-frequency / concurrent / abnormal client patterns
  against a **local Mock Server**
- Detect and mask sensitive fields in logs and reports
- Score anti-bot posture from observed responses
- Produce HTML / JSON / CSV reports

## Safety limits (defaults)

| Limit | Default |
|-------|---------|
| max_concurrency | 50 |
| max_qps | 20 |
| max_duration_seconds | 60 |
| max_requests | 1000 |
| allow_mutation_requests | false |
| allow_load_test | false |
| test_data.environment | mock (required) |

TargetGuard only allows `https://xindai.duxiaoman.com/` by default.
Localhost / private IP / metadata / non-HTTPS targets are rejected for SSRF prevention
(except the built-in Mock Server used for attack scenarios).

## Install

```bash
cd anti_bot_tester
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium
```

Requires **Python 3.11+** (verified on 3.14).

## Modes

### SAFE_DISCOVERY (default)

- Playwright page open + network recording only
- No form submit, no real PII input, no business mutation
- Output: `reports/network_flow.json` / `reports/network_flow.html`

```bash
python main.py --discover
```

### Mock Server (attack scenarios)

Attack scenarios hit the local Mock API (auto-started by CLI), not real loan apply.

```bash
python main.py --scenario normal
python main.py --scenario crawler
python main.py --scenario all
```

Standalone mock:

```bash
python -m mock_server.server
```

### LOAD_TEST

Disabled unless `safety.allow_load_test: true` in `config.yaml`.
Without that flag, concurrent workers stay soft-capped; real-target pressure stays blocked.

## CLI

```bash
python main.py --discover
python main.py --dry-run
python main.py --scenario normal|crawler|high_frequency|concurrent|replay|abnormal|sensitive_data|all
python main.py --report
```

## Configuration

Edit `config.yaml`. If `test_data.environment != mock`, startup is refused.

## Attack scenarios

| Scenario | Behavior | Target |
|----------|----------|--------|
| normal | Low frequency, single session | Mock |
| crawler | Fast GET sequence, no JS | Mock |
| high_frequency | Elevated QPS + auto-backoff | Mock |
| concurrent | Parallel workers within caps | Mock |
| replay | Safe GET replay + token anti-replay | Mock |
| abnormal | Bad UA / referer / timing | Mock |
| sensitive_data | Detect + mask PII in responses | Mock |

## Metrics

`total_requests`, success/fail, per-status counts, QPS, avg/p50/p90/p95/p99 latency,
timeouts, connection errors, rate_limit_count, security_block_count, backoff events.

## Reports

Under `reports/`: `report.html`, `report.json`, `requests.csv`, `metrics.csv`,
`security_findings.json`, plus discover `network_flow.*`.

Anti-Bot Score (0–100) is computed from observed results (429/403/auth/replay/masking),
never hard-coded.

## Tests

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
pytest -q
```

## Security notes

1. Only test systems you are authorized to test.
2. Never put real ID cards / bank cards / phones into `config.yaml`.
3. Default mode is discover-only; load tests require an explicit config flag.
4. Mutation HTTP methods to the real target are blocked by default.
5. Attack logic runs against Mock Server.
6. Sensitive values are masked before logging/reporting.

"""Sensitive field detection — never log raw matches."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass
class Finding:
    category: str
    location: str
    matched_preview: str  # already masked
    pattern_name: str


@dataclass
class DetectionResult:
    findings: list[Finding] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.findings)

    def by_category(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        out: dict[str, int] = {}
        for f in self.findings:
            out[f.category] = out.get(f.category, 0) + 1
        return out

    def has(self, category: str) -> bool:
        return any(f.category == category for f in self.findings)


# Patterns intentionally match mock AND realistic shapes for detection tests.
_PATTERNS: list[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]]] = [
    ("phone", re.compile(r"(?<!\d)1[3-9]\d{9}(?!\d)")),
    (
        "id_card",
        re.compile(
            r"(?<!\d)[1-9]\d{5}(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])\d{3}[\dXx](?!\d)"
        ),
    ),
    ("bank_card", re.compile(r"(?<!\d)(?:62|60|4|5)\d{14,18}(?!\d)")),
    ("email", re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")),
    (
        "authorization",
        re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*Bearer\s+)([A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]+=*)"),
    ),
    ("bearer_token", re.compile(r"(?i)(Bearer\s+)([A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]{8,}=*)")),
    ("jwt", re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+")),
    (
        "access_token",
        re.compile(r"(?i)(access[_-]?token\s*[:=]\s*)([A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]{8,})"),
    ),
    (
        "refresh_token",
        re.compile(r"(?i)(refresh[_-]?token\s*[:=]\s*)([A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]{8,})"),
    ),
    ("api_key", re.compile(r"(?i)(api[_-]?key\s*[:=]\s*)([A-Za-z0-9\-._]{8,})")),
    ("secret", re.compile(r"(?i)(secret\s*[:=]\s*)([A-Za-z0-9\-._]{8,})")),
    ("session_id", re.compile(r"(?i)(session[_-]?id\s*[:=]\s*)([A-Za-z0-9\-._]{8,})")),
    ("cookie_header", re.compile(r"(?i)(cookie\s*[:=]\s*)([^\n\r]{8,})")),
]

# Field-name hints when JSON keys suggest PII even if value is already masked
FIELD_CATEGORY_HINTS: dict[str, str] = {
    "phone": "phone",
    "mobile": "phone",
    "tel": "phone",
    "cellphone": "phone",
    "idcard": "id_card",
    "id_card": "id_card",
